macros.name: RCS
macros.doc: \RCS puts information from RCS fields into TeX tags.

macros.name: RCSdate
macros.doc: The tag \RCSdate (with a lowercase ‘d’) is a convenient way to put the last checkin date on the title page.

macros.name: RCSdef
macros.doc: The tag \RCSdef is like \RCS, but it additionally outputs the RCS field to the terminal.

macros.name: RCSID
macros.doc: The tag \RCSID places the keyword and the value of the RCS field in a box into the footline.

macros.name: rcsLogIntro
macros.doc: The introductionary text can be specified as the parameter of the tag \rcsLogIntro.

envs.name: rcslog
envs.doc: This package provides an environment rcslog which supports the typesetting of logs.
